derived: block mass, COM and inertia from disjoint region volumes and densities; compiled into runtime model identity
episode_instance: uniform density multiplier preserving COM and scaling mass/inertia together

rules.success: all rotated eight corners inside X[.10,.40], Y[-opening/2,opening/2], Z[.78,.85], inclusive tolerance .0005; current clipped displacement from initial x >=.355; linear speed<=.025 and angular speed<=.08; continuous 10 ticks; interruption resets; success ends episode, no release requirement
rules.distance: 50*clip((current_center_x-.10)/(.40-half_length-.10),0,1), no historical maximum; all corners inside Y/Z/back boundary with .0005 tolerance, but no front X bound; invalid position or failure =>0
rules.time: success only: 50 for t<=10; 50*(40-t)/30 for 10<t<40; zero for t>=40; elapsed includes 10 stable ticks
rules.total: distance+time; success tolerance can yield distance slightly below50; no automatic rounding up
rules.failure: center z<.65 ends and scores0; nonfinite simulation is invalid in replay
rules.timeout: 1200 steps / 60 s: preserve valid final-position distance, time0; success on final tick takes precedence
rules.reward: change in current total_score, may be negative on retreat; not official score
rules.feasibility: three-layer and evaluator checks only; no ALOHA grasp or pushing demo recertification

episode_randomization.storage: Episode variation + runtime + initial_state; Task scenario is the baseline
episode_randomization.schedule: independently shuffled five-stratum batches; two practice batches and one exam batch use the same domain; phone small count alternates 2/3
episode_randomization.replay: rebuild resolved Episode model; verify full runtime identity; restore exact initial state; no resampling during reset/step
episode_randomization.policy_visibility: qualitative runtime English instructions only; sampled values, solution axes, small-support names and files remain private
